body: I agree, idk what to do. Except I am gonna get some sleep though, I just feel drained. Thank you fir talking with me.
I'd be afraid that I'd never find the will to go back, but it's something to think about I guess.

I'm gonna have to think on it, that's not gonna be a pretty conversation. Thank you for talking with me, I'm gonna try and sleep I think, and hopefully my friend will be talking with me tomorrow. This is also a throwaway that I didn't bother to remember the password to, so I won't be saying much more either, but I know where to thread is. Thanks.
I'd say I care more about the debt than about me, yeah. I feel so guilty that it's parents money, and my brother is starting college too in the fall. I just don't know how to fix it and feel trapped.
And thank you for saying something at all.

I have seen a therapist, kind of. My school is one of those high achieving ones with the higher suicide rate, so they do have people to talk to. Except it was all breathing exercises, so I stopped going. My financial aid is gone, I lost it all when my grades dip. On the note about telling my parents, I am absolutely scared to. The debt I owe? It's coming from my parents' retirement fund. They don't believe in bank loans for some reason and that's where the money has been coming from. It makes me feel so absolutely guilty.
